title: Akhilesh Yadav Criticizes BJP Over Ram Temple Controversy
summary: Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav has criticized the BJP over the controversy surrounding the Ram temple in Ayodhya, calling for a thorough investigation into the matter. The controversy centers around allegations of corruption and favoritism related to the temple's construction.
summary_points: Akhilesh Yadav has accused the BJP of corruption and favoritism in relation to the Ram temple's construction.
The Samajwadi Party leader is calling for a thorough investigation into the matter.
The controversy centers around allegations of corruption and favoritism related to the temple's construction.
Akhilesh Yadav has criticized the BJP's handling of the situation, saying it is 'lepa-pot' (a colloquial term for favoritism).
The Samajwadi Party leader is demanding that the SIT investigation be taken seriously and that those responsible be held accountable.

summary_hi: समाजवादी पार्टी के अध्यक्ष अखिलेश यादव ने अयोध्या में राम मंदिर के चढ़ावे से जुड़े कथित मामले को लेकर भाजपा पर तीखा हमला बोला।
summary_points_hi: अखिलेश यादव ने भाजपा पर आरोप लगाया है कि उन्होंने राम मंदिर के निर्माण में धोखाधड़ी और लाभप्राप्ति की है।

अखिलेश यादव ने बीजेपी की स्थिति को 'लेपा-पोट' (एक लोकप्रिय शब्द) कहा है।
